author: A4 (D4)
schemaSource: src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts -> VietlishCorpusEntry { vietlish, natural, sourcePattern, category, frequency, context }
definition: Each entry is a NEW Vietnamese L1-interference candidate matching the live VIETLISH_CORPUS entry schema EXACTLY. These are staged for human review BEFORE any promotion into src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts. This file is imported by no engine module — review queue only. Every `vietlish` string is verified disjoint from the 354 live corpus entries by step11VietlishCorpusD4Wave.test.ts.
disjointFrom: live VIETLISH_CORPUS (src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts); A6 !690 (selector test, no corpus rows); A10 corpus waves (different files).

entries.vietlish: we wait here since one hour
entries.natural: we have been waiting here for an hour
entries.sourcePattern: doi o day mot tieng -> since/for confusion plus missing present perfect
entries.context: We wait here since one hour but the doctor still not call us.

entries.vietlish: I work here from 2019
entries.natural: I have worked here since 2019
entries.sourcePattern: lam o day tu 2019 -> tu = from/since, no present perfect
entries.context: I work here from 2019, almost five years now.

entries.vietlish: when I young I very thin
entries.natural: when I was young I was very thin
entries.sourcePattern: khi toi con tre -> copula dropped in past, very + adjective without be
entries.context: When I young I very thin, now I am bigger.

entries.vietlish: I never go to Da Nang before
entries.natural: I have never been to Da Nang before
entries.sourcePattern: toi chua bao gio di -> never + base verb, no present perfect
entries.context: I never go to Da Nang before, this is my first time.

entries.vietlish: how long you study English already
entries.natural: how long have you been studying English
entries.sourcePattern: ban hoc tieng Anh bao lau roi -> question word order plus already for duration
entries.context: How long you study English already? Your accent is good.

entries.vietlish: I see that movie two time already
entries.natural: I have seen that movie twice
entries.sourcePattern: hai lan roi -> count noun no plural, already for perfective
entries.context: I see that movie two time already but I still like it.

entries.vietlish: she leave already five minute
entries.natural: she left five minutes ago
entries.sourcePattern: co ay di duoc nam phut roi -> ago expressed as already plus bare noun
entries.context: She leave already five minute, you just missed her.

entries.vietlish: they marry ten year already
entries.natural: they have been married for ten years
entries.sourcePattern: ho cuoi nhau muoi nam roi -> duration with already, marry as state verb
entries.context: They marry ten year already and have two kids.

entries.vietlish: I need a informations
entries.natural: I need some information
entries.sourcePattern: thong tin -> treated as countable with article and plural
entries.context: I need a informations about the visa process.

entries.vietlish: he give me many advice
entries.natural: he gave me a lot of advice
entries.sourcePattern: cho toi nhieu loi khuyen -> advice pluralized, past dropped
entries.context: He give me many advice about how to find a job.

entries.vietlish: there are many furnitures in the room
entries.natural: there is a lot of furniture in the room
entries.sourcePattern: nhieu do dac -> furniture pluralized and treated as plural agreement
entries.context: There are many furnitures in the room, it feels crowded.

entries.vietlish: I drink two coffee
entries.natural: I had two coffees
entries.sourcePattern: uong hai ca phe -> drink for consume, no plural/unit
entries.context: I drink two coffee this morning to stay awake.

entries.vietlish: I lost my luggages
entries.natural: I lost my luggage
entries.sourcePattern: hanh ly -> luggage pluralized
entries.context: I lost my luggages at the airport.

entries.vietlish: he give me a good news
entries.natural: he gave me good news
entries.sourcePattern: tin tot -> news treated as countable with article
entries.context: He give me a good news today about the job.

entries.vietlish: I buy a bread at the shop
entries.natural: I bought some bread at the shop
entries.sourcePattern: mua banh mi -> bread treated as countable with article
entries.context: I buy a bread at the shop for breakfast.

entries.vietlish: we need more chair for the meeting
entries.natural: we need more chairs for the meeting
entries.sourcePattern: them ghe -> no plural after more
entries.context: We need more chair for the meeting, ten people are coming.

entries.vietlish: the childrens are playing
entries.natural: the children are playing
entries.sourcePattern: tre con -> irregular plural double-marked with -s
entries.context: The childrens are playing in the yard after school.

entries.vietlish: my teacher very strict
entries.natural: my teacher is very strict
entries.sourcePattern: thay toi rat nghiem -> adjective predicate without be
entries.context: My teacher very strict, he never accepts late homework.

entries.vietlish: she is work in a bank
entries.natural: she works in a bank
entries.sourcePattern: co ay lam o ngan hang -> be inserted before a main verb
entries.context: She is work in a bank near my house.

entries.vietlish: they are go to school now
entries.natural: they are going to school now
entries.sourcePattern: dang di hoc -> progressive marker without -ing
entries.context: They are go to school now, it is almost eight.

entries.vietlish: he is have two children
entries.natural: he has two children
entries.sourcePattern: anh ay co hai con -> be inserted before have
entries.context: He is have two children and a big house.

entries.vietlish: we are agree to the plan
entries.natural: we agree to the plan
entries.sourcePattern: chung toi dong y -> agree as adjective predicate
entries.context: We are agree to the plan, let's start tomorrow.

entries.vietlish: she was born in 1995 in March
entries.natural: she was born in March 1995
entries.sourcePattern: sinh nam 1995 thang ba -> year-before-month order from Vietnamese
entries.context: She was born in 1995 in March, the same month as me.

entries.vietlish: he arrived to the airport
entries.natural: he arrived at the airport
entries.sourcePattern: den san bay -> den maps to to instead of at
entries.context: He arrived to the airport two hours early.

entries.vietlish: we discussed on the topic
entries.natural: we discussed the topic
entries.sourcePattern: ban ve -> ve adds a preposition that English discuss does not take
entries.context: We discussed on the topic for one hour in class.

entries.vietlish: she got married with a doctor
entries.natural: she got married to a doctor
entries.sourcePattern: ket hon voi -> voi maps to with instead of to
entries.context: She got married with a doctor last year.

entries.vietlish: depend of the weather
entries.natural: it depends on the weather
entries.sourcePattern: tuy thuoc vao -> wrong preposition plus subject drop
entries.context: We may go to the beach, depend of the weather.

entries.vietlish: I will call to you tonight
entries.natural: I will call you tonight
entries.sourcePattern: goi cho ban -> cho adds an extra to after call
entries.context: I will call to you tonight after dinner.

entries.vietlish: I am afraid from dogs
entries.natural: I am afraid of dogs
entries.sourcePattern: so cho -> mapped to from instead of of
entries.context: I am afraid from dogs since I was a child.

entries.vietlish: we arrived in home late
entries.natural: we arrived home late
entries.sourcePattern: ve den nha -> home over-marked with preposition
entries.context: We arrived in home late because of the traffic.

entries.vietlish: I go to there every weekend
entries.natural: I go there every weekend
entries.sourcePattern: di den do -> there over-marked with to
entries.context: I go to there every weekend to visit my grandmother.

entries.vietlish: she is interested about history
entries.natural: she is interested in history
entries.sourcePattern: quan tam ve -> ve maps to about instead of in
entries.context: She is interested about history and old buildings.

entries.vietlish: he is angry on me
entries.natural: he is angry with me
entries.sourcePattern: gian voi/len -> wrong preposition after angry
entries.context: He is angry on me because I came late.

entries.vietlish: I eat vitamin every morning
entries.natural: I take vitamins every morning
entries.sourcePattern: uong/an vitamin -> consume verb mapped to eat, no plural
entries.context: I eat vitamin every morning for my health.

entries.vietlish: I go shower now
entries.natural: I am going to take a shower now
entries.sourcePattern: di tam -> di + activity calqued as go + bare noun
entries.context: I go shower now, give me ten minutes.

entries.vietlish: he hit the piano very well
entries.natural: he plays the piano very well
entries.sourcePattern: danh dan -> danh = hit, used for playing instruments
entries.context: He hit the piano very well, he practiced for years.

entries.vietlish: she hits makeup every morning
entries.natural: she puts on makeup every morning
entries.sourcePattern: danh phan -> danh maps to hit for applying makeup
entries.context: She hits makeup every morning before work.

entries.vietlish: please open the music louder
entries.natural: please turn the music up
entries.sourcePattern: mo nhac to len -> open for activate plus louder for up
entries.context: Please open the music louder, I like this song.

entries.vietlish: I make a photo with my friend
entries.natural: I took a photo with my friend
entries.sourcePattern: chup hinh -> make collocated with photo, past dropped
entries.context: I make a photo with my friend at the temple.

entries.vietlish: I go take rest now
entries.natural: I am going to rest now
entries.sourcePattern: di nghi -> di + activity calque plus extra take
entries.context: I go take rest now, I am very tired.

entries.vietlish: I cut my hair tomorrow
entries.natural: I'm getting a haircut tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: cat toc -> cut hair calqued where speaker means get a haircut
entries.context: I cut my hair tomorrow, it is too long now.

entries.vietlish: she bears a baby last month
entries.natural: she had a baby last month
entries.sourcePattern: sinh em be -> bear for give birth, present for past
entries.context: She bears a baby last month, a healthy boy.

entries.vietlish: I get the bus to work
entries.natural: I take the bus to work
entries.sourcePattern: di xe buyt -> get for take with transport
entries.context: I get the bus to work because parking is hard.

entries.vietlish: he catches a cold yesterday
entries.natural: he caught a cold yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: bi cam -> no past inflection on catch
entries.context: He catches a cold yesterday and stayed home.

entries.vietlish: he wear glasses since young
entries.natural: he has worn glasses since he was young
entries.sourcePattern: deo kinh tu nho -> no present perfect, clause reduced
entries.context: He wear glasses since young because his eyes are weak.

entries.vietlish: I pay by my card
entries.natural: I'll pay by card
entries.sourcePattern: tra bang the cua toi -> by + my card from Vietnamese bang
entries.context: I pay by my card, is that okay?

entries.vietlish: she takes care for her grandmother
entries.natural: she takes care of her grandmother
entries.sourcePattern: cham soc cho -> cho maps to for instead of of
entries.context: She takes care for her grandmother every weekend.

entries.vietlish: I throw the garbage every evening
entries.natural: I take out the garbage every evening
entries.sourcePattern: do rac -> throw for take out, missing particle
entries.context: I throw the garbage every evening before dinner.

entries.vietlish: the alarm rings me at six
entries.natural: the alarm wakes me at six
entries.sourcePattern: bao thuc goi -> ring for wake, transitive transfer
entries.context: The alarm rings me at six every morning.

entries.vietlish: I make exercise every morning
entries.natural: I exercise every morning
entries.sourcePattern: tap the duc -> make collocated with exercise
entries.context: I make exercise every morning in the park.

entries.vietlish: he makes a party on Saturday
entries.natural: he is having a party on Saturday
entries.sourcePattern: lam tiec -> lam = make/do used where English uses have
entries.context: He makes a party on Saturday for his birthday.

entries.vietlish: I take a decision today
entries.natural: I made a decision today
entries.sourcePattern: ra quyet dinh -> take collocated with decision, past dropped
entries.context: I take a decision today to change my job.

entries.vietlish: let me make a question
entries.natural: let me ask a question
entries.sourcePattern: dat cau hoi -> make collocated with question
entries.context: Let me make a question about the homework.

entries.vietlish: she made a high score in the exam
entries.natural: she got a high score on the exam
entries.sourcePattern: dat diem cao -> make for get plus in for on
entries.context: She made a high score in the exam, the best in class.

entries.vietlish: we make a trip to Sapa next month
entries.natural: we are taking a trip to Sapa next month
entries.sourcePattern: lam mot chuyen di -> make collocated with trip
entries.context: We make a trip to Sapa next month with my family.

entries.vietlish: he gives an exam tomorrow
entries.natural: he is taking an exam tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: lam bai thi -> give/take confusion for student sitting exam
entries.context: He gives an exam tomorrow, so he is studying tonight.

entries.vietlish: I do a phone call to my mom
entries.natural: I made a phone call to my mom
entries.sourcePattern: goi dien -> do collocated with call, past dropped
entries.context: I do a phone call to my mom every Sunday.

entries.vietlish: I get a lot of pressure at work
entries.natural: I am under a lot of pressure at work
entries.sourcePattern: bi nhieu ap luc -> get for the state of being under pressure
entries.context: I get a lot of pressure at work this month.

entries.vietlish: she pays attention on the teacher
entries.natural: she pays attention to the teacher
entries.sourcePattern: chu y vao -> vao maps to on instead of to
entries.context: She pays attention on the teacher during the lesson.

entries.vietlish: we make a meeting at 3pm
entries.natural: we are having a meeting at 3pm
entries.sourcePattern: lam cuoc hop -> make/do for have with meeting
entries.context: We make a meeting at 3pm about the new project.

entries.vietlish: he catches the train every morning
entries.natural: he takes the train every morning
entries.sourcePattern: di tau -> catch over-generalized for routine take
entries.context: He catches the train every morning to the city.

entries.vietlish: I do a research about the topic
entries.natural: I am doing research on the topic
entries.sourcePattern: nghien cuu ve -> a + research countable plus about for on
entries.context: I do a research about the topic for my report.

entries.vietlish: you go to school by what
entries.natural: how do you get to school
entries.sourcePattern: di hoc bang gi -> manner question with by what
entries.context: You go to school by what, bus or motorbike?

entries.vietlish: why she is crying
entries.natural: why is she crying
entries.sourcePattern: tai sao co ay khoc -> no subject-auxiliary inversion
entries.context: Why she is crying? Did something happen?

entries.vietlish: you can speak Vietnamese can not
entries.natural: can you speak Vietnamese or not
entries.sourcePattern: co the noi tieng Viet duoc khong -> A-not-A question pattern
entries.context: You can speak Vietnamese can not? I need help.

entries.vietlish: this is the most cheapest one
entries.natural: this is the cheapest one
entries.sourcePattern: re nhat -> most added to a superlative
entries.context: This is the most cheapest one in the shop.

entries.vietlish: a so beautiful girl
entries.natural: such a beautiful girl
entries.sourcePattern: mot co gai dep nhu vay -> so/such confusion in noun phrase
entries.context: She is a so beautiful girl, everyone looks at her.

entries.vietlish: I have a black new car
entries.natural: I have a new black car
entries.sourcePattern: xe mau den moi -> adjective order color before age
entries.context: I have a black new car, I bought it last week.

entries.vietlish: very thank you
entries.natural: thank you very much
entries.sourcePattern: cam on rat nhieu -> degree word fronted before thank
entries.context: Very thank you for your help today.

entries.vietlish: she cooks very delicious
entries.natural: her cooking is delicious
entries.sourcePattern: nau an rat ngon -> adjective delicious used as manner adverb
entries.context: She cooks very delicious, I love her pho.

entries.vietlish: teacher, today I cannot go to class
entries.natural: Teacher, I can't come to class today
entries.sourcePattern: thua thay/co -> title used as address with fronted time word
entries.context: Teacher, today I cannot go to class because I am sick.

entries.vietlish: sorry I am late, the traffic
entries.natural: sorry I am late because of the traffic
entries.sourcePattern: xin loi toi tre, ket xe -> reason given as a bare noun, no connector
entries.context: Sorry I am late, the traffic this morning was terrible.

entries.vietlish: I think so that it will rain
entries.natural: I think it will rain
entries.sourcePattern: toi nghi rang -> rang/la doubled as so that
entries.context: I think so that it will rain, bring an umbrella.

entries.vietlish: actually, I am not sure for that
entries.natural: actually, I am not sure about that
entries.sourcePattern: khong chac ve -> ve maps to for instead of about
entries.context: Actually, I am not sure for that answer.

entries.vietlish: by the way, you finished the report or not
entries.natural: by the way, did you finish the report
entries.sourcePattern: xong chua -> A-not-A tag instead of did-question
entries.context: By the way, you finished the report or not?

entries.vietlish: teacher please can repeat one more time
entries.natural: Teacher, could you repeat that one more time
entries.sourcePattern: thay oi lam on nhac lai -> modal placement and dropped object
entries.context: Teacher please can repeat one more time? I did not hear.

entries.vietlish: thanks God it is Friday
entries.natural: thank God it's Friday
entries.sourcePattern: on troi -> fixed phrase pluralized as thanks
entries.context: Thanks God it is Friday, I need a rest.

entries.vietlish: long time no see you
entries.natural: long time no see
entries.sourcePattern: lau qua khong gap -> object added to a fixed greeting
entries.context: Hi! Long time no see you, how are you?

entries.vietlish: the news make me surprising
entries.natural: the news made me surprised
entries.sourcePattern: ngac nhien -> -ing participle for the affected person
entries.context: The news make me surprising, I did not expect it.

entries.vietlish: I have a sensitive skin
entries.natural: I have sensitive skin
entries.sourcePattern: da nhay cam -> article before an uncountable noun
entries.context: I have a sensitive skin, so I cannot use this soap.

entries.vietlish: she is very sympathetic and beautiful
entries.natural: she is very sweet and beautiful
entries.sourcePattern: de thuong -> sympathetic borrowed for likeable/cute
entries.context: She is very sympathetic and beautiful, everyone likes her.

entries.vietlish: my salary is low, only enough
entries.natural: my salary is low, barely enough
entries.sourcePattern: chi du -> enough used alone for barely enough
entries.context: My salary is low, only enough for rent and food.

entries.vietlish: I want to lose my weight
entries.natural: I want to lose weight
entries.sourcePattern: giam can cua toi -> possessive added to a fixed phrase
entries.context: I want to lose my weight before the wedding.

entries.vietlish: she is pregnant five months
entries.natural: she is five months pregnant
entries.sourcePattern: co ay co thai nam thang -> duration placed after the adjective
entries.context: She is pregnant five months, the baby is due in spring.

entries.vietlish: my nose is running water
entries.natural: my nose is running
entries.sourcePattern: chay nuoc mui -> literal nose runs water
entries.context: I have a cold, my nose is running water all day.

entries.vietlish: I caught a flu
entries.natural: I caught the flu
entries.sourcePattern: bi cum -> a/the article confusion for the illness
entries.context: I caught a flu and stayed in bed two days.

entries.vietlish: the doctor injected me a medicine
entries.natural: the doctor gave me an injection
entries.sourcePattern: tiem thuoc cho toi -> verb inject with double object plus a medicine
entries.context: The doctor injected me a medicine for the pain.

entries.vietlish: my stomach is not comfortable
entries.natural: I have an upset stomach
entries.sourcePattern: bung kho chiu -> kho chiu calqued as not comfortable
entries.context: I cannot eat much, my stomach is not comfortable today.

entries.vietlish: I have a headache because I think too much
entries.natural: I have a headache from overthinking
entries.sourcePattern: suy nghi nhieu -> think too much for overthinking
entries.context: I have a headache because I think too much about money.

entries.vietlish: this bag is more expensive than that bag a lot
entries.natural: this bag is a lot more expensive than that one
entries.sourcePattern: dat hon nhieu -> intensifier a lot placed at the end
entries.context: This bag is more expensive than that bag a lot.

entries.vietlish: she is the same age with me
entries.natural: she is the same age as me
entries.sourcePattern: cung tuoi voi toi -> voi maps to with instead of as
entries.context: She is the same age with me, we were born the same year.

entries.vietlish: my phone is different with yours
entries.natural: my phone is different from yours
entries.sourcePattern: khac voi -> voi maps to with instead of from
entries.context: My phone is different with yours, mine is older.

entries.vietlish: this coffee is enough sweet
entries.natural: this coffee is sweet enough
entries.sourcePattern: du ngot -> enough placed before the adjective
entries.context: This coffee is enough sweet, I don't need more sugar.

entries.vietlish: the box is too heavy for me to carry it
entries.natural: the box is too heavy for me to carry
entries.sourcePattern: nang qua toi khong khieng noi -> resumptive object pronoun kept
entries.context: The box is too heavy for me to carry it alone.

entries.vietlish: she sings so good
entries.natural: she sings so well
entries.sourcePattern: hat hay qua -> adjective good used as adverb
entries.context: She sings so good, she should join a contest.

entries.vietlish: he runs faster more than me
entries.natural: he runs faster than me
entries.sourcePattern: chay nhanh hon -> more added after the comparative
entries.context: He runs faster more than me in every race.

entries.vietlish: my house, it is near the school
entries.natural: my house is near the school
entries.sourcePattern: nha toi, no gan truong -> topic NP plus resumptive pronoun
entries.context: My house, it is near the school, so I walk.

entries.vietlish: the food here, I think it is delicious
entries.natural: I think the food here is delicious
entries.sourcePattern: do an o day, toi nghi -> topic fronting with resumptive it
entries.context: The food here, I think it is delicious and cheap.

entries.vietlish: my mother she works in a hospital
entries.natural: my mother works in a hospital
entries.sourcePattern: me toi ba ay lam -> subject doubled with a pronoun
entries.context: My mother she works in a hospital as a nurse.

entries.vietlish: and after that, we go home
entries.natural: and after that, we went home
entries.sourcePattern: sau do chung toi ve -> past not marked in narrative chain
entries.context: We ate dinner, and after that, we go home.

entries.vietlish: I like coffee but my sister she likes tea
entries.natural: I like coffee but my sister likes tea
entries.sourcePattern: chi toi co ay thich -> resumptive subject pronoun after NP
entries.context: I like coffee but my sister she likes tea more.

entries.vietlish: I forgot my umbrella, so I am wet all
entries.natural: I forgot my umbrella, so I got all wet
entries.sourcePattern: uot het -> all placed after the adjective, no past
entries.context: I forgot my umbrella, so I am wet all when I arrived.

entries.vietlish: my computer is hang
entries.natural: my computer froze
entries.sourcePattern: treo may -> hang as a stative adjective for froze
entries.context: My computer is hang, I cannot open any program.

entries.vietlish: I forgot my password, how to reset
entries.natural: I forgot my password, how do I reset it
entries.sourcePattern: lam sao de dat lai -> infinitive how-to instead of a full question
entries.context: I forgot my password, how to reset on this app?

entries.vietlish: my phone is out of battery, can I borrow charger
entries.natural: my phone is out of battery, can I borrow a charger
entries.sourcePattern: muon cuc sac -> article dropped before a countable noun
entries.context: My phone is out of battery, can I borrow charger for a minute?

entries.vietlish: the application is loading very slow
entries.natural: the app is loading very slowly
entries.sourcePattern: tai rat cham -> adjective slow used as adverb
entries.context: The application is loading very slow, the wifi is weak.

entries.vietlish: I cannot login because forgot password
entries.natural: I can't log in because I forgot my password
entries.sourcePattern: vi quen mat khau -> subject dropped in the because clause
entries.context: I cannot login because forgot password again.

entries.vietlish: the printer is run out of ink
entries.natural: the printer has run out of ink
entries.sourcePattern: het muc -> be inserted before run out, no present perfect
entries.context: The printer is run out of ink, I need a new one.

entries.vietlish: can you screenshot and send for me
entries.natural: can you take a screenshot and send it to me
entries.sourcePattern: chup man hinh gui cho toi -> dropped object plus for instead of to
entries.context: Can you screenshot and send for me the schedule?

entries.vietlish: I reply your email already yesterday
entries.natural: I already replied to your email yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: tra loi email roi -> reply without to, already plus past time
entries.context: I reply your email already yesterday, please check again.

entries.vietlish: the meeting is move to tomorrow
entries.natural: the meeting was moved to tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: cuoc hop bi doi -> passive without -ed participle
entries.context: The meeting is move to tomorrow because the boss is busy.

entries.vietlish: how much discount can I get
entries.natural: how much of a discount can I get
entries.sourcePattern: giam bao nhieu -> discount as a bare noun after how much
entries.context: If I buy two, how much discount can I get?

entries.vietlish: do you have this shirt in size bigger
entries.natural: do you have this shirt in a bigger size
entries.sourcePattern: size lon hon -> adjective placed after the noun
entries.context: Do you have this shirt in size bigger? This one is tight.

entries.vietlish: can I try this shoes
entries.natural: can I try on these shoes
entries.sourcePattern: thu doi giay nay -> try without on, no plural agreement
entries.context: Can I try this shoes in black?

entries.vietlish: this one is broken, I want change other
entries.natural: this one is broken, I want to exchange it for another
entries.sourcePattern: doi cai khac -> change for exchange, other without one
entries.context: This one is broken, I want change other please.

entries.vietlish: the size is fit me very good
entries.natural: the size fits me very well
entries.sourcePattern: vua voi toi -> be inserted before fit, adjective for adverb
entries.context: The size is fit me very good, I will take it.

entries.vietlish: this price include tax or not
entries.natural: does this price include tax or not
entries.sourcePattern: gia nay co bao gom thue khong -> no do-support, A-not-A tag
entries.context: This price include tax or not? I want to be sure.

entries.vietlish: give me a bag please, I have many thing
entries.natural: give me a bag please, I have a lot of things
entries.sourcePattern: nhieu thu -> count noun thing without plural
entries.context: Give me a bag please, I have many thing to carry.

entries.vietlish: I missed the bus, I wait the next one
entries.natural: I missed the bus, I'll wait for the next one
entries.sourcePattern: doi chuyen sau -> wait without for, no future marker
entries.context: I missed the bus, I wait the next one here.

entries.vietlish: how far from here to the airport
entries.natural: how far is it from here to the airport
entries.sourcePattern: tu day den san bay bao xa -> copula and dummy it dropped
entries.context: How far from here to the airport by taxi?

entries.vietlish: the taxi driver drive very fast, I am scared
entries.natural: the taxi driver drives very fast, I am scared
entries.sourcePattern: tai xe chay nhanh -> no third-person -s on drive
entries.context: The taxi driver drive very fast, I am scared on the highway.

entries.vietlish: please drop me at the corner front
entries.natural: please drop me at the corner ahead
entries.sourcePattern: goc phia truoc -> front placed after noun, front for ahead
entries.context: Please drop me at the corner front, near the bank.

entries.vietlish: the train is delay one hour
entries.natural: the train is delayed by an hour
entries.sourcePattern: tre mot tieng -> adjective without -ed plus no by
entries.context: The train is delay one hour, we will be late.

entries.vietlish: which platform the train to Hue
entries.natural: which platform is the train to Hue
entries.sourcePattern: tau di Hue san ga nao -> copula dropped in the question
entries.context: Excuse me, which platform the train to Hue?

entries.vietlish: stop here is ok for me
entries.natural: you can stop here, that's fine for me
entries.sourcePattern: dung o day duoc -> bare imperative as subject clause
entries.context: Driver, stop here is ok for me, thank you.

entries.vietlish: the road is repair so we go other way
entries.natural: the road is being repaired so we'll go another way
entries.sourcePattern: duong dang sua -> passive progressive collapsed plus other for another
entries.context: The road is repair so we go other way to the office.

entries.vietlish: the salary is how much for this position
entries.natural: what is the salary for this position
entries.sourcePattern: luong bao nhieu -> embedded how much instead of what
entries.context: The salary is how much for this position, may I ask?

entries.vietlish: I have experience three years in sales
entries.natural: I have three years of experience in sales
entries.sourcePattern: kinh nghiem ba nam -> noun-number order plus missing of
entries.context: I have experience three years in sales and customer service.

entries.vietlish: I want to take a day leave tomorrow
entries.natural: I want to take a day off tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: xin nghi mot ngay -> leave for day off, wrong noun
entries.context: I want to take a day leave tomorrow for a family event.

entries.vietlish: my contract is finish next month
entries.natural: my contract ends next month
entries.sourcePattern: hop dong het han -> be plus finish for the future end
entries.context: My contract is finish next month, I am looking for new work.

entries.vietlish: the manager not yet reply my email
entries.natural: the manager hasn't replied to my email yet
entries.sourcePattern: chua tra loi -> not yet plus reply without to, no perfect
entries.context: The manager not yet reply my email about the schedule.

entries.vietlish: please send me the meeting note after
entries.natural: please send me the meeting notes afterward
entries.sourcePattern: ghi chu cuoc hop -> note without plural plus after for afterward
entries.context: Please send me the meeting note after, I have to leave early.

entries.vietlish: I am newcomer here, please help me
entries.natural: I am a newcomer here, please help me
entries.sourcePattern: nguoi moi -> article dropped before a singular noun
entries.context: I am newcomer here, please help me find the office.

entries.vietlish: we have a deadline very near, must hurry
entries.natural: the deadline is very near, we must hurry
entries.sourcePattern: han chot gan lam -> have-existential plus dropped subject in second clause
entries.context: We have a deadline very near, must hurry to finish.

entries.vietlish: he is sleeping, don't make noise loud
entries.natural: he is sleeping, don't make a loud noise
entries.sourcePattern: dung lam on to -> adjective loud placed after noun
entries.context: The baby he is sleeping, don't make noise loud.

entries.vietlish: she has a sweet voice very
entries.natural: she has a very sweet voice
entries.sourcePattern: giong ngot lam -> degree word very placed at the end
entries.context: She has a sweet voice very, she should sing.

entries.vietlish: I am very thirsty, give me a water
entries.natural: I am very thirsty, give me some water
entries.sourcePattern: cho toi nuoc -> water as countable with article a
entries.context: I am very thirsty, give me a water please.

entries.vietlish: he speaks too fast, I cannot catch
entries.natural: he speaks too fast, I can't catch what he says
entries.sourcePattern: khong nghe kip -> catch used intransitively with no object
entries.context: On the phone he speaks too fast, I cannot catch.

entries.vietlish: I will introduce you with my friend
entries.natural: I will introduce you to my friend
entries.sourcePattern: gioi thieu voi -> voi maps to with instead of to
entries.context: Come to the party, I will introduce you with my friend.

entries.vietlish: the soup needs more salt a little
entries.natural: the soup needs a little more salt
entries.sourcePattern: them mot it -> quantifier a little placed after the noun
entries.context: The soup needs more salt a little, it is bland.

entries.vietlish: I am so hungry, I can eat a horse almost
entries.natural: I am so hungry, I could almost eat a horse
entries.sourcePattern: gan nhu -> almost placed at the end of the clause
entries.context: Skip lunch and now I am so hungry, I can eat a horse almost.

entries.vietlish: he drives careless, very dangerous
entries.natural: he drives carelessly, it's very dangerous
entries.sourcePattern: lai au -> adjective careless used as an adverb
entries.context: He drives careless, very dangerous on the wet road.

entries.vietlish: she wears a perfume very strong
entries.natural: she's wearing very strong perfume
entries.sourcePattern: xit nuoc hoa thom -> article plus adjective after noun
entries.context: She wears a perfume very strong, I can smell it from far.

entries.vietlish: the class has finished, students go out all
entries.natural: the class has finished, all the students are going out
entries.sourcePattern: ra het -> quantifier all placed after the verb
entries.context: When the class has finished, students go out all at once.

entries.vietlish: I don't have time to do all this works
entries.natural: I don't have time to do all this work
entries.sourcePattern: cong viec -> work pluralized as countable
entries.context: I don't have time to do all this works before Friday.

entries.vietlish: the river water is very dirty now
entries.natural: the river is very dirty now
entries.sourcePattern: nuoc song -> redundant water noun before adjective
entries.context: After the rain, the river water is very dirty now.

entries.vietlish: I will keep contact with you
entries.natural: I will keep in touch with you
entries.sourcePattern: giu lien lac -> keep contact for keep in touch
entries.context: After I move, I will keep contact with you by email.

entries.vietlish: he gave back me the money yesterday
entries.natural: he gave me back the money yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: tra lai tien cho toi -> particle placement, back before object
entries.context: He gave back me the money yesterday, so we are even.

entries.vietlish: please turn left at the next light
entries.natural: please turn left at the next traffic light
entries.sourcePattern: den giao thong -> light for traffic light, ambiguous noun
entries.context: To my house, please turn left at the next light.

entries.vietlish: my English is still weak, sorry
entries.natural: my English is still poor, sorry
entries.sourcePattern: tieng Anh con yeu -> weak calqued for poor ability
entries.context: Please speak slowly, my English is still weak, sorry.

entries.vietlish: I want to study abroad, my dream from small
entries.natural: I want to study abroad, it's been my dream since I was little
entries.sourcePattern: tu nho -> from small for since childhood
entries.context: I want to study abroad, my dream from small until now.

entries.vietlish: she is doing the master in London
entries.natural: she is doing a master's in London
entries.sourcePattern: hoc thac si -> the for a plus master without 's
entries.context: She is doing the master in London for two years.

entries.vietlish: I eat outside tonight with my team
entries.natural: I'm eating out tonight with my team
entries.sourcePattern: an ngoai -> eat outside for eat out, no progressive
entries.context: I eat outside tonight with my team to celebrate.

entries.vietlish: the teacher gave us a lot of exercise
entries.natural: the teacher gave us a lot of exercises
entries.sourcePattern: nhieu bai tap -> exercise uncountable-marked here
entries.context: The teacher gave us a lot of exercise for the weekend.
